title: Kohler shower backing plates - fit trial and installation handoff
policy: Use accepted calipers and credible local scan features to select supported approximations. Preserve conflicts; do not average the reflective scans or apply a depth correction to the coplanar plate survey. No new owner measurement is requested. The plumber assembles, adjusts and tests.

owner.title: Order one pair; choose one material route
owner.lead: Recommended first trial: one clear acrylic main plate and one clear diverter. The broad upright main opening preserves access; the trial resolves real contact before metal finishing or permanent installation.
blocks: Upload one file per part, quantity1 each

CLEAR_FIT_TRIAL/FT02_MAIN_220_T1500_FIT_TRIAL_PONOKO_K020_CUT.dxf
CLEAR_FIT_TRIAL/FT02_DIV_124_T1500_FIT_TRIAL_PONOKO_K020_CUT.dxf
Select Clear Acrylic1.50 mm and Cutting. These paths already allow0.20 mm nominal kerf; no second compensation.
Real comparison

$43.79 clear pair vs $80.47 stainless pair, ordinary delivery included; estimated26 October2026. Tax not separately shown. Metal1.52 mm is1.84x, but diverter is AS CUT; its deburring/cosmetic finishing cost remains open. Metal-first is reasonable only with that work arranged. See ponoko/quotes.json.
Why no fixed bolt tabs?

The measured mounting layout was evaluated. Tight tabs conflict with captured rods; larger holes add movement beyond the extra gasket reserve. Center with the removable front border guide. Plain access leaves the real factory attachments adjustable.
Bring to the visit

Bring the pair, original trim and PLUMBER_START_HERE. Check full gasket contact, support, cover/handle engagement, both plates together and drain before sealing. Obtain the optional RF01 form only if support is missing. Quotes are saved; nothing purchased.

plumber.title: Start with the actual installation
plumber.lead: The owner needs an over-cut cover and a sound landing for the existing gasket while preserving the travertine. This is a fit-trial part, not a replacement for the factory trim or concealed waterproofing.
blocks: Parts to identify

Main: Purist K-T14489-4-BN over K-2973-KS-NA. Separate diverter: K-T14491-4-BN over K-737-K-NA. Verify the hardware revision. Upper main control is volume; lower is thermostatic. Bring the correct factory adapters/screws, spline adapters, hubs/bonnets or rings, nuts, plate/gasket and handles.
Already known

Foam is attached to the inner plate and meets its outer edge; approximately 6 mm wide/deep, 15.44 mm uncompressed total stack. Owner confirms the 4.56 inch trim rods touch rear wood. The two mounting bores are 5.66 mm; final planar layout is R006. Installed tip distances were taken in 3D.
First supported fit

Remove decorative trim/inner plate only as needed. Keep the factory hardware organized and protect cartridges. Slide the custom backing over the exposed hardware; reinstall foam-backed inner plate, nuts, decorative cover and correct handles in that order. Nuts stay behind the unperforated decorative face. Support the inner assembly; do not tighten across a void.

plumber.title: Separate three depth problems
plumber.lead: Adjusting a trim rod does not move the control shaft. Diagnose the factory attachment before proposing valve relocation.
blocks: A - Trim rods meet wood

Kohler stud 1038645 is 10-24 x 4.56 inches overall (115.824 mm). Guide 1041504-2-F limits projection to 7/16 inch (11.1125 mm) from the finished wall and calls for adjustment when the plate will not sit flat. This is not a stem limit or automatic permission to add sheet thickness to the datum. Inspect the actual new seating stack.
Wood relief is conditional

Inspect the member and nearby pipe/cable from the open rear. If wood blocks retraction and other depths pass, choose local clearance that preserves the member, services and rod engagement. No blind depth, automatic rod cutting or tile drilling is specified.
B - Adapters and handles

Try the correct factory adapter/screw combination and verify full hub/bonnet or ring attachment. Main guide lists short/middle/long adapters with corresponding upper/lower screws; see reference links. Diverter uses #1/#2/#3 options. Do not substitute a generic screw or use tightening to compensate for poor engagement.
C - Valve position

Only if appropriate adapters and rod adjustment cannot make the complete supported stack work, assess valve depth/alignment. Include actual sheet plus support/bedding height. No numeric move is justified by the reflective scan. Refit both plate templates before committing a changed valve position.

plumber.title: Support, seal, test and hand back
plumber.lead: No new CAD survey is expected. If a trial fails, mark the exact interference/contact location and provide one useful photograph.
blocks: Supported trial

Center the main backing on the cover with the removable guide; verify the entire factory foam band lands on metal. Check the diverter rear plate/contact ring separately: 80 mm is a trial aperture, not a measured gasket diameter. Both backings must seat without rocking, sliding or bowing; keep a visible neighbor gap.
Two support branches

If the sound stone already supports the complete assembly, retain it. If a specific contact zone lacks support, rebuild that zone on solid backing through rear access where practical. Do not bridge with loose grout, silicone or unsupported mortar. The guide gives material roles and a concealed-waterproofing inspection branch.
Water paths and success checks

New outer backing-to-stone seal is continuous. The factory cover drain remains open at 6 o'clock and drains onto the FRONT of the backing. Preserve service removal. After required cure: verify handle travel, safe temperature limit/function, dry rear during plumbing use, then controlled shower-spray ingress check. Stop on movement, leakage, trapped water or incomplete factory attachment. Record actual part revision and outcome; permanent use remains unverified until these pass.

guide.title: 1. Receive and protect the parts
guide.lead: Owner + installer | Tools: printed drawing, straightedge, caliper, nonmarring gloves and surface protection.
blocks: Inspect incoming parts

Confirm FT02 MAIN220 and DIV124/80, one each. Ponoko #4 metal is1.52 mm nominal,0.004 mm below the earlier1.524 engineering nominal. Clear is1.50. Inspect actual thickness, profile, flatness, safe edges and face. Catalog stock ranges: #4 steel1.44-1.64; acrylic1.27-1.73. Requested flatness0.5 mm is not supplier-guaranteed. No3 mm substitute.
Use paper for XY only

Print the Letter tiles at 100% and measure BOTH scale bars before trimming. Align the overlap crosses. The blue cutting profile is separate from the dashed cover/gasket overlay. Paper confirms outline/coverage; it does not establish stack depth, stiffness or water performance.
Completion check

Parts match the selected route and no sharp edge can scratch the stone or gasket. Preserve film during handling, but remove film from final contact/seal areas before evaluating the actual stack. Do not force a warped plate flat with factory nuts.

guide.title: 2. Fit factory parts and center the backing
guide.lead: Kohler installer | Tools: proper factory components and tools, nonmarring paper/card border guide, removable tape.
blocks: Make access

Remove handles, decorative cover and foam-backed inner plate as required. Retract/remove trim studs only if needed and restore correct engagement. Main backing passes over hardware through the single broad capsule; the knobs attach from the front through the FACTORY openings. They are not additional holes in the custom part.
Center without permanent tabs

Use the dashed factory-cover circle and outer circle on the 1:1 overlay, or cut the radial border gauge. Hold the actual cover in its intended location and compare the visible border at top/right/bottom/left. Main nominal border is 17.925 mm; diverter 12.7875 mm. Support with removable low-tack tape outside seal areas. Remove the guide from the FRONT; nothing remains under the gasket.
Trial complete stack

Include the actual backing thickness and required support stand-off. Verify all main foam lands on metal, inner plate seats, nuts remain under the cover, handles attach and turn freely, factory drain is down, and the diverter rear contact sits fully on the new ring. No cut or forced bend. If wrong, mark the interfering location rather than measuring the whole shower.
Completion check

Both circles remain concentric and separated; the assembly can be removed normally. Correct factory clamping on solid support must prevent shifting. Tape and sealant are not assumed permanent structural retention.

guide.title: 3. Provide solid support where it is needed
guide.lead: Installer + tile/stone specialist if required | Keep the original tile intact. Inspect through the existing rear opening.
blocks: Branch A - Sound contact

Dry-fit metal on clean sound stone. If the perimeter seal zone and factory clamp/gasket zones are adequately supported without bowing or rocking, no full-opening rebuild is required. Preserve that stable load path.
Branch B - Local missing support

Mark only unsupported bearing zones. Through rear access, provide securely supported cementitious backing on suitable framing/cleats without new tile penetrations. Fit sound stone or compatible cementitious infill to those zones, supported while curing and flush enough for the plate to sit without force. Keep repair and fasteners clear of pipes, valve mounting and service access. Do not use an adhesive dab as a freestanding support column.
Bonding option and limits

254 PLATINUM Plus is a candidate thin-set for compatible stone on cementitious backing; it is not cavity filler or waterproofing. Use the actual manufacturer sheet for substrate preparation, mixed bed thickness, support and water-exposure cure. LATAPOXY 310 may bond supported sound stone to compatible dry substrates, but porous/fissile material needs a suitability check. Neither product authorizes grinding the existing tile.
Concealed-waterproofing branch

If the rear reveals wet, crumbling material or a disrupted membrane, the specialist must identify and repair that system with a compatible detail before wet service. A surface bead or metal cover cannot demonstrate an unseen membrane connection. Record the selected repair, materials and cure; then repeat the same dry fit.

guide.title: 3A. Optional form-assisted local repair
guide.lead: Repair contractor | Use only after a support gap is found. REPAIR_FORM_SETUP gives the separate three-page procedure; the two plate files are unchanged.
blocks: Prepare and place

Confirm sound permanent backing and suitable substrate. Rehearse insertion and straight withdrawal of RF01 with actual hardware; preserve cartridge/tool access. Line it with removable PE, set three matched pads on sound tile, and brace it independently from the front. The full panel must seat without force or rocking.
Fill from the rear

Protect the valve. Hand-place only the required front12 mm repair zones outside the collar, supported by backing and outer shuttering. Do not fill the central service cavity or cast around pipes. Use the product-specific preparation/mix/cure; Cement All is conditional on compatible cementitious substrate, not presumed adhesion to travertine or board.
Remove all temporary pieces

After contractor-confirmed stripping strength, release the brace and pull toward the shower. Remove film, pads, protection and shuttering. No permanent plastic remains. Inspect support, voids and service clearance; repeat the same plate dry fit, then resolve sealing/waterproofing and cure before water tests.

guide.title: 4. Seal the new interface; keep drainage
guide.lead: Installer | Tools/materials: approved nonstaining stone-compatible sealant system, primer where required, mask and joint tooling.
blocks: Two separate seals

The original foam seals against the FRONT of the new backing. The new seal closes the OUTER backing-to-travertine perimeter on sound stone. Its path must lie outside all over-cuts. Keep the factory cover bottom notch open; it drains onto the front of the backing. Do not make an aligned gap in the new rear perimeter seal.
Candidate seal system

LATASIL with LATASIL 9118 primer is a researched candidate for porous stone and stainless, subject to a small adhesion/staining test. Remove contaminants and contact-surface protective film using methods compatible with the finishes. Follow the sealant joint design; its sheet specifies width 3-25 mm, depth at most 12 mm and roughly 2:1 width/depth. Use backer rod or bond-breaker tape where the joint needs it. Do not substitute an unqualified paper-thin smear or assume silicone supports the plate.
Finish and cure

Tool a continuous accessible perimeter joint, preserve service clearances, remove masking promptly and allow the complete selected system to cure. LATASIL generally needs 24 hours at 21 C before water, longer if conditions require; actual repair mortar/membrane may govern a longer interval. Record the product/lot, conditions and earliest permitted water test.
Completion check

The supported plate remains centered and stable, the entire foam band has contact, the new seal crosses no void, and the factory drain is visibly open. If the actual edge cannot accommodate a valid joint or sound substrate, resolve that detail before wet use.

guide.title: 5. Assemble, operate and test
guide.lead: Kohler installer | Use correct factory instructions for the actual revision. Maintain rear access for observation when practical.
blocks: Factory assembly

Fit correct adapters/screws, foam-backed inner plate and its nuts; install the decorative cover with drain down; secure handles through their factory hubs/bonnets or rings. Check full engagement and travel without scraping. Never drill the decorative cover for protruding nuts. Added depth is actual sheet plus bedding/support, not a generic 5 mm allowance.
Separate plumbing check

With correct hardware installed, test operation and temperature-limit setting per Kohler. Observe rear piping and valve for leakage while running water without wetting the trim exterior. Pressure-system work belongs to the plumber. A leak here is not repaired by the new escutcheon.
Separate external-water check

After all required cure, apply controlled normal shower spray to the assembled trim while observing accessible rear surfaces. Confirm drainage and no new moisture around the opening. Stop, dry and identify the route if water enters. Do not interpret one local test as certification of concealed shower waterproofing.
Completion check

Record FT02, material and actual thickness, adapter choice, stud remedy, support/seal system, cure completion, handle/drain results and the two water-test outcomes. Until passed, keep the part labeled fit trial.

guide.title: 6. Service, maintain and report a failed trial
guide.lead: Owner + installer | Retain the drawings and the actual installed revision with the factory instructions.
blocks: Future removal

Remove handles and cover using the factory sequence. The custom backing normally remains while the inner assembly is serviced. If backing removal is needed, carefully release its accessible outer seal without cutting the tile or disturbing hidden repairs. Recreate the seal and repeat the relevant cure/test steps. Do not permanently bond serviceable factory parts into the opening.
Routine care

Use finish-compatible, neutral-pH cleaning. Check for a loose plate, open perimeter joint, blocked factory drain or moisture. Do not caulk the factory drain closed. Repair damaged sealing after identifying the cause.
If something does not fit

Mark which part contacts what, and capture one focused photograph plus the failed action (cannot slide on / cannot seat / cannot attach / cannot turn / loses gasket contact). This is enough to separate an ordinary factory adjustment from a necessary CAD change. No new broad survey or 75-field form is required.
Status boundaries

Valid exports mean coherent geometry. Private quotes were obtained; no purchase or physical check has occurred. Actual received parts must establish fit, support, sealing, cure and water performance before permanent use.

costs.delivered_pair_prices: Ponoko private formal quotes, 16 October 2026: one main plus one diverter. Clear acrylic1.50 mm: $43.79 including ordinary delivery. #4 304 stainless1.52 mm: $80.47 including main linear deburring and ordinary delivery; diverter remains AS CUT. Tax is not separately shown; additional diverter finishing is not included. Both estimate26 October arrival (3 business-day production plus UPS Ground), subject to order timing.
costs.decision: Recommended first trial: clear acrylic at $43.79 because the remaining gasket/contact checks are easier to see and the metal diverter has no quoted deburring option. Metal is1.84x this price before that missing finishing. If a qualified finisher will smooth all diverter edges at acceptable cost, metal-first remains reasonable with the same selected geometry. Do not use an as-cut edge against tile or gasket. Both choices accept possible remake risk; neither is permanent-use approval.
costs.print_fallback: Use T1520 metal STL for a thickness-matched print only if clear is unsuitable. No part-specific print quote exists; plastic does not establish metal stiffness or water performance.
